name: pricing-page
title: Pricing page
description: TopNav, a short page intro, pricing-table with comparison, FAQ about billing, CTA band, site footer.

frame.summary: Same shell as landing-page; the h1 is the pricing-table's heading.

decisions.why: The pricing table's heading is the h1; a hero above it pushes the plans below the fold for a page whose readers came for the plans.

decisions.decision: The billing period is in the URL query
decisions.why: So a shared link shows yearly prices if that is what was shared; pricing-table reports the change, the page writes the URL.

landmarks.label: implicit; target of the skip link

obligations: First focusable element is a skip link to <main> — there is no skip-link component, so it is VisuallyHidden content that becomes visible on :focus-visible (open question: promote to a component).

native.reason: Website-only by decision B3 (gate-1 review, docs/decisions/2026-11-gate-1-review.md): marketing blocks and templates ship on the web only and get no native version. See pricing-table: native purchase flows follow store billing rules.

tokenGaps.need: A page content max-inline-size (container width) for marketing bands
tokenGaps.interim: The band's content box is capped at calc(var(--rata-size-control-lg) * 32) and centred with auto inline margins; the playground's own column cap is a literal with a comment saying there is no measure token. The container max-width token is sent to the design-tokens interview (gate-1 review); this multiplier is the interim until it lands.
Composed from visually-hidden; every template needs one, which is the argument for making it a component.

tokenGaps.need: A z-index / layer scale for the sticky header
tokenGaps.interim: The playground uses z-index: 1 with a comment; templates do the same until a layer token exists.

openQuestions: Pricing-table's plan headings are h2 here (base+1 with base 1) and the comparison is also h2 — confirm that plans and comparison are siblings in the outline.
